about.title: About me
about.greeting2: I'm Željka, the creative force behind Drveni Val.
about.greeting_text: The doors of Drveni Val are open every day during working hours. I invite you to come and peek into my little piece of the maritime world and find the perfect souvenir from Novi Vinodolski.
about.welcome_p1: Many years ago, I left my long-time job and realised my creative dream — I moved to the beautiful Adriatic coast. In Novi Vinodolski, one of the charming towns on the Croatian coast, I found my oasis of peace.
about.welcome_p2: Here I opened my creative studio — a workshop and art shop located along the Adriatic highway, near the town centre. At Drveni Val, I handcraft souvenirs from recycled wood and driftwood washed ashore by the sea.
about.welcome_p3: My passions are the sea and art. In every piece of driftwood I find, I see the potential for unique creations. I believe that even the smallest piece of nature can become a beautiful souvenir.
about.section1_heading: The magical beauty of the sea
about.section1_text1: The marine world has always fascinated me. In every piece of wood, I see a story, magical beauty, and endless inspiration. My souvenirs are small pieces of the Adriatic, captured in time and transformed into unique works of art.
about.section1_text2: Driftwood, remains of masts, canvas, and everything I find on the beaches — these are my materials. I consider them gifts from the sea, as each has its own story, and I give them a new purpose.
about.section2_text1: Using these gifts, I want to convey the beauty of the Adriatic as I see it. My works are lively and vibrant, inspired by the colours of the sea, marine life, and the charms of the coast. Each piece is unique, handcrafted with much love and care.
about.section2_text2: I believe that art is a way to connect with nature and appreciate its beauty. My souvenirs are not just decorative objects, but also a reminder of the importance of preserving the sea and caring for our planet. My mission is to inspire people to think about sustainability and recycling.
about.section3_text1: At Drveni Val, you can find unique souvenirs for yourself or your loved ones. In every souvenir I create, I invest a part of myself and tell the story of my life on the coast and by the sea.
about.section3_text2: May these small pieces of the Adriatic bring a part of the beauty and magical maritime world into your home.
about.inspiration_intro: Novi Vinodolski is my place for living and inspiration. It is a town that has won me over with its charm, beauty, and hospitality. And it is precisely these impressions that I want to convey through my work.
about.inspiration_p1: Besides the sea and its gifts, I draw inspiration from life in Novi Vinodolski, a small town nestled between the beautiful Adriatic Sea and the green mountains of Gorski Kotar.
about.inspiration_p2: Novi Vinodolski, rightly known as a jewel of Croatian tourism, has been offering its visitors an unforgettable tourist experience for over 200 years. Besides the enchanting beaches, which remain a favourite destination for tourists, the town offers many other activities.
about.inspiration_p3: Lovers of active holidays can enjoy cycling trails stretching through the beautiful surroundings, mountain trails leading to fantastic viewpoints, diving in the crystal-clear waters of the Adriatic, tennis, football, bocce, and many other sports.
about.inspiration_p4: Novi Vinodolski is also known for its two beautiful marinas, which attract numerous sailors. And for those who want to enjoy gastronomic specialties and fine wines, the town and its surroundings offer a rich selection of restaurants and taverns.
about.inspiration_p5: I strongly encourage you to explore everything Novi Vinodolski has to offer.
